19:12 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NBA Basketball
The Indiana Pacers host the Philadelphia 76ers in NBA regular-season play at Gainbridge Fieldhouse. The Philadelphia 76ers have won four straight meetings against the Indiana Pacers, including a 105-94 victory at this venue last April.
